description: Petroleum Title Tract Polygons is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tenure and Resource Stewardship. A single tenure can have multiple parts and also multiple stratographic layers or tracts. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Tenure and Resource Stewardship. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
